title: Daynori Web/PWA Design Verification and Theme Capture Correction

targetedAreasRefined.refinement: Demoted #today-create-btn to secondary and desktop-only to remove mobile button duplication with AppHeader; promoted #customize-today-btn to primary variant to establish clear page-level action; eliminated button row wrapping at 320px.
Added #mobile-menu-theme-toggle under Utilities in the mobile navigation drawer with >= 48px touch target, mode icon, and dynamic mode subtitle.
Removed redundant 80px Feedback informational banner, bringing all 5 entity creation chips into the first viewport on 320px screens; added dark mode border to chip icon badges.
Added explicit :focus-visible ring outline (2px solid border.focus, -2px offset) and dark mode icon badge boundary borders.

Cleanly collapsed non-functional auxiliary interactive controls (knowledge sources, starter suggestions, voice capture) when gated under DEF-V2-008, presenting a calm, truthful, compact 220px view on mobile.

localTestDisclaimer: Screenshots are not production proof without testing the interaction. All tests run in local synthetic headless environments.
